sucha.diet_advice: If you have dry skin, it's important to consume foods that hydrate from within. Focus on healthy fats that support the skin's natural protective barrier. Include omega-3 fatty acids from sources like fatty fish (salmon, mackerel), nuts, flaxseeds, and avocados. Additionally, drink plenty of water to maintain proper skin hydration.

tłusta.diet_advice: For oily skin, avoid foods high in sugar and trans fats as they can worsen skin issues. Choose low-glycemic foods like whole grains, vegetables, nuts, and seeds. Incorporate vitamin A-rich foods (carrots, sweet potatoes) to help regulate sebum production.

mieszana.diet_advice: A balanced diet is key for combination skin. Focus on foods rich in vitamins and minerals like vitamin C (citrus fruits, bell peppers), vitamin E (nuts, seeds), and zinc (meat, pumpkin seeds). Maintain a balance between hydration and oil control.

normalna.diet_advice: Even normal skin benefits from antioxidants. Include berries, tomatoes, and green tea to protect against oxidative stress. Maintain healthy fats (olive oil, nuts) to support skin elasticity.

wrażliwa.diet_advice: For sensitive skin, avoid inflammatory triggers like processed foods, spicy spices, and alcohol. Focus on anti-inflammatory foods rich in vitamin C (citrus, kiwi), vitamin E (almonds, nuts), and omega-3s (salmon, walnuts) to soothe irritation.

dojrzała.diet_advice: Mature skin benefits from collagen-boosting foods. Focus on vitamin C (citrus fruits, tomatoes), green vegetables (broccoli, kale), and omega-3-rich fish to maintain elasticity and reduce wrinkles.

odwodnienie.diet_advice: For dehydrated skin, prioritize water-rich foods: cucumbers, watermelon, tomatoes, and citrus fruits. Stay hydrated with water and avoid dehydrating carbonated drinks.

trądzik.diet_advice: Combat acne with vitamin A (carrots, spinach), zinc (nuts, seeds), and antioxidants. Avoid high-sugar foods that can exacerbate breakouts.

poszerzone pory.diet_advice: Minimize enlarged pores with B vitamins (spinach, bananas) and vitamin C (citrus, bell peppers) to improve skin elasticity and sebum control.

suche plamy.diet_advice: Address dry patches with hydrating foods: avocados, nuts, olive oil, and omega-3-rich fish. Include vitamin E sources (almonds, seeds) for skin repair.

podrażnienia.diet_advice: Soothe irritation with anti-inflammatory foods: turmeric, ginger, berries, and nuts to support skin recovery.

linie mimiczne.diet_advice: Reduce fine lines with collagen-supporting foods: citrus fruits, strawberries, tomatoes, and omega-3-rich fish.

zmarszczki.diet_advice: Slow wrinkles with antioxidant-rich foods: berries, citrus fruits, avocados, and fatty fish to boost collagen production.

nierowny koloryt.diet_advice: Even skin tone with vitamin C-rich foods: citrus fruits, kiwi, and bell peppers to brighten dark spots and improve complexion.

bladość.diet_advice: Combat paleness with iron-rich foods (spinach, red meat), vitamin C for absorption, and folate (broccoli, avocado) to improve skin radiance.

czarne punkty.diet_advice: Reduce blackheads with vitamin A (carrots, sweet potatoes) and zinc (nuts, pumpkin seeds) to cleanse pores and improve skin texture.

zatrzymane pory.diet_advice: Clear clogged pores with vitamin A (carrots, peppers) and vitamin C (citrus fruits) to regulate sebum and improve skin elasticity.

przebarwienia.diet_advice: Fade hyperpigmentation with vitamin C-rich foods: citrus, kiwi, berries, and green vegetables to lighten spots and reduce inflammation.

utrata jędrności.diet_advice: Improve skin firmness with collagen-supporting foods: citrus fruits, fatty fish (salmon), avocados, and nuts for elasticity.
